question: Choose the word that is the antonym of **Humidity**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dryness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Humidity"** refers to the presence of moisture in the air or the quality of being damp or moist. (आर्द्रता)

 
 
• **Example:** The humidity in the room made it uncomfortable to stay for long.
 
 
 
• **"Dryness"** refers to the absence of moisture or the quality of being dry. It is the opposite of humidity. (शुष्कता)
 
 
• **Example:** The dryness of the desert air makes it difficult for plants to thrive.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Humidity"** is **"Dryness."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dryness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dampness **(नमी): Refers to slight wetness or moisture.

 
 
• **Example:** The dampness in the walls caused the paint to peel off.
 
 
 
• **Moisture **(आर्द्रता): Refers to water or other liquid diffused in a small quantity.
 
 
• **Example:** Plants absorb moisture from the soil to grow.
 
 
 
• **Wetness **(गीलापन): Refers to the condition of being covered with water or another liquid.
 
 
• **Example:** The wetness of his clothes showed that he got caught in the rain.
